doc.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998

title: Deciding to return from Europe
summary: He returned because the record was a hit and he decided he had every right to be in America.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well when you were in Europe, you considered staying you said. You considered staying in Europe. But you didn’t.
You eventually came back, and why did you decide?

Well I came because the record was a hit, and they kind of convinced me, they said go over there and make some money and then come back. I says okay, that’s what I did. Then when I got over here I says it’s ridiculous for me to run away from the place where I’m born, I’m raised, I have every right to be here, more so than some other people. So why should I — so I stayed. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
